title: Tools And Equipment Board Deck
request: Oct 19 2026 12:07 ICT: Max asked for a Tools & Equipment board deck covering its own sections Tech Tool Bag, Van Inventory Tracking and Ordering (bag checklists, condition, last checked, van stock with min/par, low-stock flags, order requests with Requested / Needs Max's approval / Approved / Ordered / Received, supplier and cost placeholders). Final tool list, van setup and suppliers are OPEN. Ordering never buys without Max's approval.
example_data: Laptop browser mockups (1366 wide) of the Tools & Equipment board, generic category names only, Open placeholders for undecided lists and suppliers, every item labelled TEST, Forecast or Decided. No real names, addresses or phones.
built_at_note: UpKeep board decks, Oct 19 2026 12:02-12:07 ICT requests
brands: Standard deck look (white, light beige accents, Khand/Hind)
Mockups: white/cream base, terracotta, lagoon and jungle accents, UP house mark, light only
